Renchi Zhang 张任驰

PhD candidate · Cognitive Robotics · TU Delft

I build robots and study how people work with them. My PhD explores where humans and AI differ in perception, reasoning and action, through real robotic systems and controlled experiments.

I’m interested in embodied intelligence, human–AI complementarity, and how an agent can learn from its own failures. I like building things that people can actually use.
